content.title: Bunge Global (NYSE:BG) Reports Sales Below Analyst Estimates In Q3 CY2025 Earnings
content.summary: Global agribusiness company Bunge Global (NYSE:BG) fell short of the markets revenue expectations in Q3 CY2025, but sales rose 71.6% year on year to $22.16 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $2.27 per share was 15.3% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
